hub.intro: Looking for {game} teammates? Join a room that matches your platform and rank below, or open your own. Team up with mic'd players in your language and skill level in seconds — no downloads, no hunting through Discord servers for {game}.
hub.empty: No rooms match these filters. Be the first to open one!
hub.a1: Browse the open {game} rooms and hit 'Join' on one that fits. If there's no suitable room, use 'Create Room' to open your own and players will join you.
hub.a2: Yes, opening and joining {game} rooms is completely free. Premium only adds priority matchmaking and extra perks.
hub.a3: Steam, Epic, PlayStation and Xbox players can host {game} rooms, and you can filter rooms by platform.
